system.description: Eating all or part of a lindwurm’s heart heals wounds, cures diseases, and restores unusable or missing body parts; recovery time depends on the injuries. After eating it, the target makes a Situation Value 16 test (Constitution). On a failure, it falls into a magical sleep and becomes a lindwurm after 1d10 weeks; that lindwurm returns to its original form when it dies.
system.summary: Heals the target, at the risk of transforming it into a lindwurm.
